verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to a-Shell. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at holzschu.github.io/llms.txt), and the docs and README are written for human users, with nothing aimed at agents. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
